summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery command in operator wup

delivery.outcome: Remove the code2llm 'Shotgun Surgery: command' report for src/koru/autonomy/operator/operator_wup.py (PLF-042) by making argv-list mutation live in exactly one helper, _build_command(base, *groups), the only function that assigns and grows a command list. _wup_watch_command becomes a single _build_command expression whose optional testql and --config flag groups are passed as conditional groups; a _compose_command(compose_file, profiles, *trailing) wrapper owns the shared 'docker compose -f <file> [--profile p]...' prefix for both former construction sites, so _compose_ps_command returns _compose_command(..., "ps", "--format", "json", service) and _ensure_wup_profiled_compose_services builds its up argv through the same wrapper. The read-only consumers stop rebinding the name 'command': _wait_for_compose_service_ready uses ps_command, _ensure_wup_profiled_compose_services uses up_command and _start_wup_watch uses watch_command. Produced argv lists are byte-identical to before; the subprocess/Popen call sites, timeouts and env handling are untouched. tests/test_autonomous.py keeps every existing wup argv pin and adds focused tests for _build_command group semantics (None/empty skipped, base copied) and the _compose_ps_command profile ordering.
nonGoals: Changing any produced argv, flag order, default, timeout or environment lookup
Renaming the public surface or the read-only planfile_command locals of _wup_subprocess_env
Deduplicating _wait_for_compose_service_ready's polling loop or any other operator_wup smell
Touching operator.py, operator registry siblings or the systemd watcher contract

architecture.decision: Centralize argv mutation in a single pure helper, _build_command(base, *groups), that copies the base list and extends it with each truthy group; every conditional flag becomes a conditional group argument at the call site. The docker-compose prefix knowledge additionally collapses into _compose_command(compose_file, profiles, *trailing), the only place that knows the base verb order 'docker compose -f <file> [--profile p]... <trailing>'. No module extraction is needed (the smell is intra-module), so there are no new patch targets and the import surface is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the single ticket commit to restore the three scattered command constructions.

validation.evidence: The only command assignment and the only command.extend live inside _build_command.
All existing wup argv pins (watch command modes, compose up/ps ordering, profile flags) plus the new _build_command and _compose_ps_command tests pass.
Full autonomy suite passes; no baseline regression.
Governance gate reports 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
